have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
  intro hx0
  have : (1 / x) = 0 := by simpa [hx0] using (one_div x)
  have : (3 : ℝ) + 0 = (7 : ℝ) / 0 := by simpa [hx0] using h₁
  simpa using this
have hmul : (3 : ℝ) * x + 1 = 7 := by
  have := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t * x) h₁
  -- (3 + 1/x) * x = (7/x) * x
  -- simplify both sides
  simpa [mul_add, add_mul, hx, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using this
-- from 3x + 1 = 7, get x = 2
linarith
